benefit: Mint volatiles disrupt the host-finding behavior of imported cabbage moth (Pieris rapae) and diamondback moth. Mint grown in pots placed in the row keeps the plant from running and overtaking the bed.

members.title: Potted mint at brassica row ends and corners
members.body: Place mint pots every 8 to 10 ft along the brassica block edges. Trim plants to keep aromatic foliage active. Do not plant directly in the bed; mint becomes invasive.
